subject: Re: Quick recap + are budget/approvals still on track for EoQ?
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@horizonci.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + short recap from today's discovery

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have alignment before EoQ:  

1) Current priority: CI test generation pipeline (prod) — primary goal is to reduce developer turnaround time on flaky tests and shorten feedback loops.
2) Usage profile: ~25 engineers initially, ~200k tokens/day in peak test-cycle runs.
3) Constraints: must run in VPC, SOC2 evidence needed, and procurement prefers a one-year commit if pricing can be firmed.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- I will attach a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and dates — can you review and mark any constraints by Monday? (attached)
- If MAP looks good, we can put a draft SOW/pricing in front of procurement for an initial review this week.
- Optional: 30-min tech deep-dive with your infra lead; I can bring our PK lead and a solutions engineer.

I've attached the MAP and a preliminary pricing PDF for reference. If you want an internal slide for stakeholders, I can produce a 1-pager.

Are you still targeting an EoQ procurement decision? If timelines have shifted, let me know and we'll adjust the MAP accordingly.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0129

Attachments: horizonci-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), horizonci-pricing-proposal.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@horizonci.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Gentle nudge — MAP review + EoQ timing

Hi Jane —

Following up on the MAP I sent last Friday. Quick reminder: our team is holding a slot for procurement review this Thursday (11/26) to try to meet your stated EoQ target. If the approval path or budget has changed, no problem — just want to know so we don't assume the Thursday slot.

Two quick asks:  
- Can you confirm whether procurement will be available for a quick touch on 11/26? (15–20 min)
- Has priority shifted internally given end-of-quarter activities?

If you'd prefer, I can route the MAP through your procurement email (copied below) and Ben can join the call.

Thanks —
Alex

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@horizonci.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Gentle nudge — MAP review + EoQ timing

Alex —

Thanks for the follow-up and for the clear MAP. Apologies for the delay — we've had a short freeze placed on new vendor commitments this week while finance reconciles a Q4 forecast swing. Short answer: priority has shifted to essential spend only, and procurement has been told to pause external negotiations until the CFO approval meeting next Tuesday (12/01).

That said, there is interest from engineering; they asked for the MAP and a super-brief technical appendix for the infra team. Can you send a 1-page architecture note (how Redwood would plug into our VPC and key SOC2/gov controls) and I'll make sure it gets in front of the infra manager.

I'll keep you posted after the 12/01 meeting. If the CFO green-lights, procurement will be open to a short review cycle mid-December, but I don't expect anything before January unless there's a narrow exception.

— Jane
Head of Platform Engineering | Horizon CI
jane.doe@horizonci.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Horizon CI timing update — next steps

Forwarding Jane's note — good intel. Two quick internal asks:  

1) Alex — please produce a one-pager architecture note (VPC onboarding + SOC2 evidence pointers) by EOD today so I can pass it to our SE and they can tailor it for Jane's infra manager.
2) Ben — hold off on booking the procurement review slot for 11/26; we'll circle back after Jane's 12/01 CFO touchpoint. If finance signals a narrowed exception, we can try mid-December.

Also, mark this deal as at-risk in the pipeline and change close-plan to "deferred" with a note: "CFO freeze pending 2026-12-01". I'll coordinate with RevOps on any temporary credit or pilot concession if needed.

-Marissa
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
